description.content: Device operations provide the ability to manage ThingPark devices, device profiles, routing profiles, and connectivity plans.

description.content:
KPN’s Low Power Long Range (LoRa) network service compliments existing 2G, 3G, 4G and LTE-M networks. It is based on the LoRaWAN protocol for Internet of Things (IoT). ### Key highlights - **Sandbox:** Full-fledged capabilities. - **Security:** HTTPS, OAuth, Rate limiting. - **Versioning:** Supports version-less API, version tight. If no version is provided (in the header) it defaults to latest version. --- ## [Source view](https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis/kpn/lora-device-management-kpn/)
